dataset_name: Cholo Bondhu Durga Puja Pandal Dataset — research-enhanced seed
purpose: Offline-first candidate dataset for Cholo Bondhu. Not an exhaustive or fully field-verified city directory.

production_safety.coordinates_warning: The enriched coordinates are reported by third-party directory pages and require independent verification before being used for turn-by-turn routing.
production_safety.theme_warning: 2026 themes are reported by third-party pages and are not necessarily official. Where sources conflict, do not publish as confirmed.
production_safety.photo_warning: Photo/gallery URLs point to source pages. Do not download, rehost, or redistribute photos without checking licence/permission.
production_safety.live_data_warning: No live crowd, operating hours, traffic, or transit data is provided.
production_safety.route_warning: Only use coordinates after validation. Keep records visible in list search when coordinates are missing/unverified.
